subject.title: feat(feishu): route exact DMs with fail-closed enforcement

question: Should exact `conversationId` matching become a durable generic core route-binding contract, with Feishu owning only the opt-in fail-closed policy?
rationale: The branch adds a shared public binding field and a new channel setting; tests establish intended behavior but cannot choose the permanent core-versus-plugin API boundary.

options.title: Approve the shared binding contract
options.body: Keep `bindings[].match.conversationId` generic, document its cross-channel semantics, and retain `dmRouteFailClosed` as Feishu-only policy.

options.title: Keep conversation routing plugin-owned
options.body: Move exact conversation selection behind a Feishu plugin configuration/seam so core route bindings do not gain a provider-identifier field.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared binding contract
recommendation.body: Keep `bindings[].match.conversationId` generic, document its cross-channel semantics, and retain `dmRouteFailClosed` as Feishu-only policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu inbound routing work makes this the strongest available owner candidate for the channel/core boundary decision.
